title: Nutty Turkish Milk Kazandibi
description: A traditional Turkish dessert featuring a creamy milk base, crunchy nuts, and a caramelized crust, made with pickle juice and lardons-render for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Combine milk, pickle juice, and lardons-render in a saucepan and heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whisk together sugar, cornstarch, and salt.
Gradually add the dry ingredients to the milk mixture, whisking constantly to prevent lumps.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Stir in the chopped walnuts and vanilla extract.
Pour the mixture into a salt-block vessel and refrigerate for at least 2 hours.
Just before serving, caramelize the top of the kazandibi with a kitchen torch or under the broiler.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional chopped walnuts if desired.
